text.p: SME - Stefan Hajdu, a Slovak citizen kidnapped by a group of Chechens at the end of July, was released on Sunday after the intervention of the regular Chechen army. Hajdu said his abduction had no connection with the political situation in Chechnya.
- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar has accused the Czech media of carrying out a disinformation campaign to damage Slovakia's image.

- The Speaker of the British House of Commons, Betty Boothroyd, on Sunday arrived for a four-day official visit to Slovakia. She is scheduled to addres a session of parliament and meet Meciar and Parliamentary Chairman Ivan Gasparovic.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The National Property Fund (NPF), the state privatisation agency, last week approved the privatisation of another 26 state companies. The sale totalled around 5.6 billion crowns.
- The association of Slovakia's textile and clothing firms, including the industry's 70 main firms, posted losses of more than 131 million crowns in the first half of this year.
- The Agriculture Ministry is demanding state subsidies for the industry of 9.6 billion crowns next year, some 2.4 billion more than in 1996.

NARODNA OBRODA - Foreign Minister Pavol Hamzik said he would make an official trip to Budapest next week and that he was also planning a visit to Washington in near future where he expected to meet the "highest level" U.S. representatives.
